title: OMA build backlog
description: Lives at .oma/04-build/tasks.json. Written by the PM (initial breakdown), QA (failure tasks), and the orchestrator (status reconciliation). Build agents NEVER write this file directly during parallel work — they report tasks_completed in their handoff and the orchestrator reconciles, because two agents writing one file concurrently corrupts it.

next_id.description: Next numeric id to assign. Task ids are permanent — never renumber, never reuse.

req.description: The requirement this serves. A task with no REQ is scope creep and gets rejected.

stage.description: foundation = sequential scaffold work; feature = parallel-safe; fix = QA-filed repair.

acceptance.description: The command or check that proves this done. 'npm run typecheck passes' / 'GET /api/invoices returns the contract envelope' / 'screen matches mockups/invoices.html incl. all 5 states'. Never 'works correctly'.

evidence.description: For fix tasks: pointer into a QA report or commands.jsonl line that shows the failure. For done tasks: what proved completion.
